items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And he had a great lead alto player, Earle Warren. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Earle Warren.

ctx.x: And he had a great lead alto player, Earle Warren.
People forget Earle Warren. “Smile” they used to call him. He used to smile when he played. He was great, man.
